label: FLUX / Krea — Bild

must: Write flowing natural-language sentences, not comma-separated tags.
Open with subject and action, then wardrobe and body detail, then environment, then light, then camera.
Name concrete materials, textures and colours instead of adjectives like beautiful or detailed.
State the lighting setup explicitly: source, direction, hardness, colour temperature.
When a subject sits, lies or leans on furniture, state the scale so proportions do not drift: 'realistic human proportions relative to the furniture, same scale as a real adult'.
avoid: Negative prompt syntax — FLUX ignores it.

notes_for_model: FLUX follows long natural prose reliably and rewards precise spatial language. Put the single most important visual fact in the first twelve words.
